declarations.description:
Progress indicator, drawn as a bar (`linear`, the default) or a ring (`circular`). Without a `value` the
indicator slides across the track indefinitely; with one it fills the track from the start edge and animates
between values. Text in the default slot labels the bar and doubles as its accessible name, and `show-value` adds the percentage on the opposite side — override that text with the `value`
slot to count something other than percent. Track and indicator are two plain boxes, so height, radius, colours
and speed are all variables. Use `c2-spinner` when the wait has no natural width to fill.

The `circular` variant draws the same track and indicator as a ring `--c2-progress--size` across and
`--c2-progress--height` thick, starting at the top and filling clockwise. `show-value` (or the `value` slot) prints
the value in the middle of the ring and the label sits underneath; without a value the arc spins.

`marks` puts milestones on a `linear` track (tiers, thresholds, rewards): a dot at each one's value, with its label
under the track. A milestone is `locked` until the value reaches it and `reached` from then on, unless its own
`state` says otherwise (`claimable` for a reward waiting to be claimed). Each one is announced with its state, a
locked one with the distance left to it, and `nextMark` hands that distance to the application's own label.
declarations.name: Progress

members.name: marks
members.description:
Milestones on a `linear` track, as JSON in the attribute or an array in the property: `{ value, label?, state? }`
each, `value` in the units of the bar's `value`. The `circular` variant ignores them.

members.name: renderMark
members.description: Draws each milestone's label in place of its `label` text. The dot, its place and its announced state stay the component's.

members.name: effectiveMax
members.description: Value that fills the track, guarding against a `max` of `0` or less.

members.name: clampedValue
members.description: `value` clamped to `0`–`max`; `undefined` while indeterminate. Announced as-is, so it keeps the author's precision.

members.name: nextMark
members.description: First milestone ahead of the value, with the distance to it; `undefined` if none, or while indeterminate.

declarations.description:
The thin bar across the top of the page while a route changes or a request runs. `start()` shows it and trickles
it forward, in smaller and smaller steps that never reach the end; `done()` fills it and fades it out. The same
run is the `active` property, for a framework that binds a "navigating" flag instead of calling methods. Starting
again while the bar fades out begins a new run.

Put one on the page. It draws across the top of the viewport in the top layer, above dialogs and anything
positioned; `contained` draws it at the top of the nearest positioned ancestor instead, for a panel or a frame
that loads on its own. The trickle is not a measure of the work: the bar is announced as a progress bar with a
name and no value. Use `c2-progress` for work whose share done is known.
declarations.name: NavigationProgress

members.description: Whether a run is under way: `true` shows the bar and trickles it forward, `false` fills it and fades it out. `start()` and `done()` set it.

members.name: contained
members.description: Draws the bar at the top of the nearest positioned ancestor instead of across the top of the viewport in the top layer.

members.description: Fills the bar and fades it out. Does nothing when no run is under way.
